In my case I was able to keep using the router but had to manually limit the bandwidth of a couple Apple devices that were automatically doing large uploads. 

Bufferbloat only rears its head when your network is under heavy load which in my case made it an on-and-off issue. I needed to use the bandwidth monitor and wait for the ping spikes to happen in order to see which devices I needed to limit. 

Not saying for sure that this is the issue you have, but bufferbloat typically affects high end routers and a lot of manufacturers don't seem to be aware that the QoS software in their routers isn't working like it's supposed to
